name: R3-eval-RM-Bench-new
description: An evaluation suite for reward models (RM) that measures how well RMs align with human preferences across a variety of prompt/response pairs, typically via pairwise comparisons or rankings. It tests a model's ability to reproduce human judgments and rank outputs according to human preferences.
reputation: Used within the rubricreward/reward modeling community for RM evaluation; known among alignment and preference-modeling researchers but not a universal standard.
